factSheet.title: Example Agri AI Raises Seed Round for Swahili Crop Advice

claims.text: The company says Example Agri AI, based in Nairobi, raised 2.4 million dollars in seed funding.
claims.label: Seed round

claims.text: A public filing lists Example Ventures as the lead investor.
The company says 150 farmer cooperatives are using the service.
claims.label: Cooperatives onboarded

claims.text: The company says it plans to enter 3 more countries next year.
claims.label: Planned new markets

claims.text: The assistant gives crop advice in Swahili and Kikuyu.
The company is registered in Kenya according to the business registry.
